relatedSnapshot.title: ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error: reconnect sends mailboxId=undefined ("Mailbox not found")
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

Pre-warmed mailboxes provisioned through ColdMailReseller get stuck in an Error state and cannot send, because no reconnect path resolves a mailbox id the provider will accept.

## Problem

When a ColdMailReseller pre-warmed inbox disconnects or needs reconnecting, the account-error reconnect flow fires with `mailboxId: providerId ?? undefined`. These inboxes have `mail_inbox.provider_id = NULL`, so the provider receives `mailboxId=undefined` and the OAuth connect returns "Mailbox not found", leaving the inbox permanently in Error.

## Root cause

`apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts` invokes `processConnectOAuth` with `mailboxId: inboxLookup.providerId ?? undefined`. `processConnectOAuth` (`process-connect-oauth.ts`, `connect-mailbox-oauth` step) forwards that `mailboxId` to ColdMailReseller `POST /mailboxes/oauth` via `apps/web/lib/mail/providers/coldmailreseller/client.ts#connectMailboxOAuth`, which rejects it with "Mailbox not found". The inboxes have `mail_inbox.provider_id = NULL`, so the id is never resolved. The reconcile cron (`reconcile-domain-orders-cron.ts`) already looks up the mailbox from ColdMailReseller and passes `mailbox.id` correctly, so the resolution pattern exists.

The failing invariant is one gap across every entry point: no reconnect path resolves the mailbox id from ColdMailReseller before calling the provider. The webhook path forwards the stored `mail_inbox.provider_id`; the customer Reconnect action (`email-accounts.ts`, `triggerOAuthReconnect`) and the admin reconnect (`admin-domain-orders.ts`) both send `mailboxId: undefined`; `processConnectOAuth` never re-resolves. An inbox carrying a named but no-longer-valid id fails identically to one with a NULL id, which is why both counts below sit in this one class.

## Blast radius

5,762 inboxes across 444 organizations carry a `connection_error` containing "Mailbox not found" (query: `SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT organization_id) FROM mail_inbox WHERE connection_error ILIKE '%Mailbox not found%'`, counted 2026-09-24: 5,762 inboxes / 444 organizations, and 7,071 reconnect sessions across 461 organizations failed the same way in the 30 days to 2026-09-24; was 5,763 / 445 on 2026-09-23, 5,660 / 439 on 2026-09-22, 4,364 / 323 on 2026-09-10 and 294 / 39 on 2026-08-28). None of the 5,762 is connected now. 2,391 of them carry the exact `mailboxId=undefined` signature (and all of those have `provider_id IS NULL`); the larger 3,371 carry a named mailbox id and fail the same way. Named-id rows arrive in platform waves (2026-09-04 to 09-06 roughly 2,118 rows across 95+ organizations; 2026-09-19 to 09-20 roughly 1,148 rows across 103 organizations), so the shape is systematic rather than org-specific. A further 2,872 connected pre-warmed inboxes across 228 organizations sit at `provider_id IS NULL` and would fail the same way on their next reconnect.

## Proposed fix

Resolve the provider mailbox id before reconnecting: look up the mailbox from ColdMailReseller (as the reconcile cron already does) instead of passing `provider_id` or `undefined`, and backfill `provider_id` for the affected inboxes so they reconnect successfully.

## Done when

* No reconnect path hands ColdMailReseller an unresolved id: the webhook path stops forwarding the stored `provider_id` unresolved, the customer Reconnect and admin reconnect stop sending `undefined`, and both shapes (NULL `provider_id` and stale named id) reconnect successfully.
* The stuck inboxes are recovered or re-provisioned and resume sending.
* Provider accounts with no local `mail_inbox` row are covered too: Reconnect refuses them outright (`email-accounts.ts#triggerOAuthReconnect` throws PRECONDITION_FAILED "Only managed inboxes can be reconnected.") while their inbox entitlements are still consumed, so the backfill and re-provision step must create or link the missing rows, not only repair a NULL or stale `provider_id`.

## Reports

* ENG-13156
* ENG-13255
* ENG-13511
* ENG-14104
* ENG-14131
* ENG-14197 Customer report: all 15 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error; Reconnect returns Mailbox not found; campaigns cannot send
* ENG-14201 Customer report: 15 of 36 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error; Reconnect returns Mailbox not found and never clears the inbox

relatedSnapshot.title: Customer report: all 15 pre-warmed inboxes stuck in Error, Reconnect returns "Mailbox not found", campaigns cannot send
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Source

Intercom conversation: <url:app.intercom.com>

## Bounded conversation context

Customer reports (2026-09-22) that every pre-warmed inbox in the workspace shows an Error status, that reconnect attempts stay at "Reconnect in Progress" for over 48 hours, and that toggling an inbox to enabled briefly shows Active before it returns to Error. On 2026-09-23 she adds that her campaign stopped running and that she cannot start any new campaigns. Frontline agent reactivated the inboxes on 2026-09-22 and confirmed they still failed, then escalated to the tech team.

* Product area named on the conversation: Email accounts & domains
* Workspace: cold email agent email-accounts page, 15 pre-warmed inboxes across 5 domains (5 completed pre-warmed orders, all provisioned 2026-03-30)

## Testable claim

Every pre-warmed inbox in the workspace is in Error and cannot be reconnected: the Reconnect path sends a mailbox id ColdMailReseller does not resolve, so the provider answers "Mailbox not found" and the inbox never returns to Active, which leaves the workspace with no sending accounts and blocks campaign sending.

## Current evidence

* 15/15 mail_inbox rows status=error, connected=false; 14 carry "Disconnected via Company One account_error webhook", 1 carries the "Mailbox not found" OAuth exception.
* 53 Company One account_error webhook events between 2026-09-19T15:07Z and 2026-09-23T05:57Z for these accounts.
* 15 failed cea_oauth_sessions, each with "Mailbox OAuth connection threw an exception: Mailbox not found. Context: mailboxId=<stored provider_id>, email=<address>", between 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-22.
* Last email_sent webhook for the workspace: 2026-09-18T19:37Z. One campaign is still "active" with no sends; three campaigns sit in draft.
* Provider side: the corresponding Company One accounts exist in the workspace sub-workspace and report warmup activity, so the durable failure is the Acquisity reconnect path, not a missing provider account.

## Suspected code path

* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-account-error-reconnect.ts (processAccountErrorReconnect) marks the inbox Error and invokes processConnectOAuth with mailboxId = stored mail_inbox.provider_id.
* apps/web/trpc/routers/outreach/email-accounts.ts (triggerOAuthReconnect) sends mailboxId: undefined for a customer-initiated Reconnect.
* apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/process-connect-oauth.ts forwards that id to ColdMailReseller POST /mailboxes/oauth.

relatedSnapshot.title: Auto-reconnect disconnected Name 1 inboxes via Company One account_error webhook
relatedSnapshot.description:
**Problem**                                                                                                                                             

Name 1 randomly disconnects inboxes from Company One, requiring manual reconnection. 

**Current** **State**

* The existing reconcileDomainOrdersCron only retries inboxes that failed during **initial** **provisioning** (orders with requires_attention status)
* There is no mechanism to detect or fix inboxes that disconnect **after** successful initial connection
* Company One provides an account_error webhook event that fires when a connected email account has a connection issue, authentication failure, or is paused due to plan expiration

**Proposed** **Solution**

**1.** **Register** **account_error** **webhooks**

* For all existing organizations with an Company One provider, register an account_error webhook pointing to a new API endpoint in our app
* Register the webhook automatically for new organizations when their Company One provider is set up

  **2.** **Name 15** **handler** **endpoint**

* Receives account_error events from Company One
* Identifies the affected email account
* Checks our provisioning logs to confirm it's an inbox we own (ignore accounts users connected directly through Company One)
* Triggers the existing reconnection flow: initGoogleOAuth() → ColdMail completes OAuth → pollOAuthSession polls until connected
* Deduplication: skip if an OAuth session is already in-flight for that inbox

  **3.** **Backfill** **cron** **(one-time** **or** **infrequent)**

* A one-time migration to register account_error webhooks on all existing organization workspaces
* Optionally keep a low-frequency daily cron as a safety net to catch any missed webhook events

  **Considerations**

* **Deduplication:** Avoid triggering reconnection if an OAuth session is already active for that inbox
* **Retry** **limits:** Cap reconnection attempts per inbox to avoid infinite loops
* **Provider** **filtering:** Only attempt reconnection for Name 1 inboxes (provider_code: 2) provisioned through ColdMail
* **Name 15** **verification:** Validate incoming webhook requests are from Company One
* **Name 16:** Handle duplicate webhook deliveries gracefully

relatedSnapshot.title: Pre-warmed inbox OAuth stuck in "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection" (recurring)
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Overview

Cold email pre-warmed inboxes keep landing in an Error state with "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection", so campaigns can't send from those accounts. Repeat customer reports confirm this is an active cluster, not a one-off.

## Problem

When a workspace connects pre-warmed mailboxes, some mailboxes complete Name 1 OAuth while others land in an expired "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection" state on the provider side and never finish. Those inboxes surface as Error with 0 of 30 sent and stay disconnected, cutting campaign volume.

## Root cause

The OAuth session for these mailboxes returns an `expired` status from the Zapmail/ColdMailReseller side. `pollOAuthStatus` in `apps/web/lib/inngest/functions/campaign/workspaces/poll-oauth-session.ts` (lines 159-172) turns that into `{ success: false, error: 'expired', description: 'Waiting on zapmail oauth connection' }`, and `recordConnectionFailure` in `oauth-connection-failure.ts` marks the inbox `status = error`, `connected = false`. Sibling inboxes in the same batch complete, so the customer is completing the flow; these specific mailboxes keep expiring on the provider side.

## Blast radius

503 inboxes across 222 organizations carried `status = error` and `connection_error = "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection"` as of 2026-08-26.

## Proposed fix

Make the pre-warmed mailbox OAuth reconnect resilient: when the Zapmail side returns an expired/abandoned session, retry or keep the mailbox reconnectable until the provider completes the connection, instead of leaving the inbox parked in a terminal Error state. Confirm with the mail provider why these sessions expire even when the customer completes Name 1 authorization.

## What's included

* Root-causing why the Zapmail OAuth session reaches `expired` when sibling mailboxes in the same batch complete.
* A reconnect path that recovers these inboxes without manual provider intervention.

## Done when

* Reconnected pre-warmed inboxes stop landing in the "Waiting on zapmail oauth connection" terminal state.
* Existing affected inboxes are recoverable from the product without a manual provider-side operation.

## Reports

* ENG-13158 (Name 17)
* ENG-12731 (Name 18)

relatedSnapshot.title: All 16 sending accounts in Error and revert to red after re-enabling; Reconnect did not fix it
relatedSnapshot.description:
## Customer report

```text
Customer Name 24 (owner, workspace Company Seven) launched a campaign this morning and no emails went out. He says he reviewed and enabled all his email inboxes, they show green, and when he leaves the screen they turn back to red (Error). He says he already tried Reconnect and it is still the same, and he asked for a ticket. His screenshots show the campaign Options email account picker with "0 selected" and several accounts marked Error, and the All Inboxes list showing Active badges.

What the results recorded (saved state plus a live sending-account read at 2026-10-13 18:40 UTC):
- 16 sending accounts read, none truncated. All 16 are in the error bucket (provider status -1, no error code returned). Ready: 0, paused: 0, setup pending: 0, initial warmup: 0. None has a last-used date. Each shows warmup score 100 and warmup status 1, daily limit 30.
- Accounts: <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>, <email>.
- Account errors reported by the provider in the last 7 days for all 16 accounts. Most recent: <email> 2026-10-13 18:37 UTC (2 errors), <email> 18:31 (2), <email> 18:30 (2). The other 13 each have one error around 2026-10-12 23:05 to 23:45 UTC. This shows which accounts errored and when, not why.
- The connection is Acquisity-provisioned and active, with no saved connection error. Name 15 is registered, last event 2026-10-13 18:37 UTC, 19 events in 7 days, 0 webhook errors. No stale-sync accounts.
- No reconnect attempts are recorded for this workspace in the last 7 days (reconnectAttempts is empty), even though the customer says he tried Reconnect. So I could not see what Reconnect returned or why it did not hold.
- Separately, 20 purchased pre-warmed inboxes (e.g. <email>, <email>, <email>) are disconnected with the saved reason "Mailbox removed because the domain subscription ended", last retried 2026-09-19 to 2026-09-20. These are a different set from the 16 live accounts and look like a billing/subscription cause. They are not the same as the 16 erroring accounts.

Problem for Engineering: the 16 live accounts report Error from the provider with no error code, while the customer re-enables them and they flip back to Error, and none can send. The cause of the Error on these 16 is not visible from the saved data. Please check why the provider flags these accounts and why re-enabling does not hold, and whether the Reconnect action actually ran for this workspace (no attempt was recorded).

Expected outcome: the 16 accounts become Active and the customer's campaign can send.
```
